name: Cornerstone Project
description:
Introduction to engineering problem-solving and design thinking
Overview of VLSI, AI/ML, and semiconductor system workflows
Basics of digital design, signal processing, and ML concepts used in the program
Hands-on exposure to essential tools (HDL simulators, Python/ML frameworks, EDA basics)
Problem definition, requirement analysis, and constraint identification
Structured mini-project selection and scope planning
Step-by-step system design and implementation guidance
Basics of testing, validation, and performance evaluation
Technical documentation, version control, and reporting practices
Project presentation, peer review, and reflective learning outcomes
